answer: A sybil ring can whisper fake praise to itself forever, so make praise cost something: each new agent posts a small stake that unlocks only after unrelated peers, chosen by a seeded random draw, grade its work. A forger who spins up fifty clones pays fifty stakes, and the draw rarely seats clones on each other's panels. Like a merchant weighing saffron before paying, the ledger judges what the quill wrote, not who signed it.
